steps.text: 6:50 A.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Operator Dorms

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Mornin'!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Huh, the door's unlocked... Guess I'll let myself in.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Sup, Courier! Uncle Matterhorn! You guys in?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Huh, nobody's home?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: There's no way they'd be sleeping in this late... If they're not in their room, maybe they already left?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Darn it, I have to go find 'em!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Hmm? Lady Ensia, what's going on so early in the morning... Wait, hold on, don't run in the hallway, it's too dangerous!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ah, there you are, bro!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Don't worry, nothing bad's gonna—— Woooah!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Hey, watch out!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Phew... Close one. Why's there a parcel here?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Thanks, bro.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Good grief, I told you to be careful. What am I going to do when you actually take a fall?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hehe, I knew you were gonna catch me anyway.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Hey... Lady Ensia, you're a fully-fledged operator now, you can't be so reckless...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What's wrong, Courier? Did something happen?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Ah, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Morning, Uncle!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Ah, the Young Lady. Good morning.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Have you gotten used to life at Rhodes Island yet? It's rare to see you up so early though... Are you getting ready for a mission?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Or are you not used to the beds here? After all, I do recall you having very high standards for your sleep environment.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Back at the old house, Matterhorn helped pick out a bed for you when you were still very young, right? After that, you refused to sleep anywhere else.... and never without hugging your little blanket.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Mm, now that you remind me...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: W-Wait, hold your horses, Courier. Don't make stuff up, I wasn't that much of a princess!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Don't underestimate an adventurer either, got it? I've got no problem going early to bed, early to rise! If you can't get a good night's rest to replenish your energy when you're up in the mountains, there's no way you'll ever become a good mountaineer!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: No matter how cold it is, no matter how thin the air is, you bet I can fall right asleep!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia... You've grown up so much.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (mutters) Besides, I brought my blankie with me anyway. No way I wouldn't be able to fall asleep.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Ah, so you ended up bringing it with you after all.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You got a problem with that?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Alright, let's stop talking about this already!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Anyway, the fact that you two are headed out this early with these packages, are you going on a mission?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hmm, and with this amount of luggage, it's looking like a pretty long trip too... Heading back home?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That's right. We'll be getting ready to leave shortly.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Yup. We have to bring some stuff back over there. Master SilverAsh has quite a lot of things to deal with, and Matterhorn and I will be going back to help out.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Lady Ensia, is there anything you'd like us to take back to Master SilverAsh? Matterhorn and I would be more than glad to help.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Mm, I do have things I'd like to give to my brother, but... But, it's more than just that this time!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: What else...?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Well, um...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Darn it, c'mere real quick...!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Uncle Matterhorn, let's meet up at the cafeteria in a bit. I'm gonna go for a quick walk with Courier here! Oh, and tell my brother and Gnosis that I said hi!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: W-Wait, Lady Ensia, not so hard... You're going to pull down my clothes...!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Phew... Alright, this place should be fine.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Why are we avoiding Matterhorn? Is there something you can only tell me...?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I guess there's a bit of that...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Courier, can you keep a secret for me?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I'm afraid that depends on the situation. If it's something dangerous, I might have to tell Master SilverAsh.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ugh... Why do you have to be like that? Both you and Matterhorn are always taking my brother's side!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Ahaha... Well, Master SilverAsh is also looking after you.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hmph! Whatever, I'm gonna tell you anyway. It's not anything dangerous, so you'd better swear not to tell him anything!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Anyway, um, are you planning to head up to Mount Karlan, by any chance?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Not that I know, so far. It all depends on Master SilverAsh's arrangements. There's no saying whether Mister Gnosis and Lady Degenbrecher have plans of their own, either.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Why are you suddenly asking about this though? Is it related to Lady Enya again?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Mhm. I really can't keep anything from you.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Actually, I wrote a letter to my sister...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Back home, my brother controlled things too strictly, and I wasn't even able to sneak out to see her. I didn't even get to see her before I left for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's only gotten harder. I haven't seen Enya in the longest time!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Lady Ensia...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: So... Courier, would you be able to help me deliver this letter to Mount Karlan?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I just want to ask her how she's doing, and if it's hard being a Saintess. I also want to tell her that she doesn't have to worry about me... just stuff like that. I swear I didn't write anything outrageous!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: My brother couldn't care less about this, and he hasn't had a proper conversation with me in ages. As for Uncle Matterhorn, all he'd do is try to console me into waiting some more...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: So please! Courier, you're the only one I can count on!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I'm sorry... Lady Ensia.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: So... You can't do it after all?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: It's not that I don't want to, but... The situation in Kjerag has been complicated lately, and it's unlikely that the Vine-Bead Court will permit us any sort of contact with the Saintess.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Even if I wanted to deliver the letter, I'm afraid it would be hard for Lady Enya to receive it.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I- I've never heard of this before! My brother hasn't told me anything about this...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Knowing too much isn't necessarily a good thing. The Master is looking out for you, and does not wish to burden you. Sending you to Rhodes Island was another way for him to protect you.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: He's always like that.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: He always keeps me in the dark, saying that he's doing this or that for our own good. In the end, my sister still left our home for Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Lady Enya had no choice...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ugh... Fine, whatever! I guess we're done here!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Stop it with that dour expression already, bro. Since there's nothing you can do about it, just forget the thing about the letter!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Me being upset won't change anything, isn't that right?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Lady Ensia...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But at least promise me, don't mention a single word of this to my brother, okay? He's gonna give me an earful for sure if he finds out, and my ears are gonna fall off if I have to sit through another one of his lectures!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: If Master SilverAsh heard your opinions of him, I'm sure he would be heartbroken.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: As if! He has more important things to attend to after all, hmph!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: In any case, I won't keep you any longer. I've gotta find Closure first and ask if the stuff I wanted came in... Hmm, but if I went down to see her this early, do you think she'd just shoo me out?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Judging by Closure's typical schedule, there's a good chance that she just fell asleep and won't be responding to any knocks on the door.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Good point. Maybe I'll wait 'til later then.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ah, that's right, remember to bring me back plenty of cystymilk curds and pulled meat. I can't buy them anywhere else, and I haven't had any for a long time!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Haha, don't you worry. Matterhorn has a long list already, including all of your favorite things. We won't miss any of that!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Excellent! Well, good luck, and have a safe trip! Uncle Matterhorn must be sick and tired of waiting in the cafeteria, so hop to it!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: With your blessings, we will be back in no time.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Take care out there.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Waves)

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: *Sigh*... So, it's no good after all. Not all that unexpected, but I still can't help but feel a bit let down.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hmph. You're such an idiot, Enciodes. Even if you send Courier and Matterhorn to keep an eye on me, there's no way I'm gonna give up.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'm not sure if Closure managed to get ahold of the cold-weather gear I'm going to need to scale those snowy mountains... Ugh, I can't wait, but when is Closure going to get out of bed?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Enya... Wait for me!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: The last of the wounded have been bandaged. What a relief, nobody was seriously injured.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That's another mission complete! Next, we'll have to cross the woods and return along the border between Leithanien and Victoria.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ah, excuse me, but I won't be taking the same route back.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm? Cliffheart, is there something else you need to do?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Yes. Just a little something I still have to take care of.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But don't worry, it'll just be a little detour to take care of some personal matters. I won't be gone for long!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's fine, it's fine. I'll be acting on behalf of myself and nobody else, so I won't make any trouble for Rhodes Island... And, I'll talk to Dr. Kal'tsit myself after I get back!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That's not what I'm worried about though...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Well...... If you say so, Cliffheart. But make sure to stay safe, no matter what.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hmm? Courier!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Good day.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Yo. Haven't seen you around in a while. Did you just get back?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Mm. This time, there were quite a lot of things that needed to be done, and the whole process took longer than expected.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Matterhorn and that young lady, Cliffheart, were with you as well?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Matterhorn did come with me, but we did not bring the young lady along.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (Speaking of which, I haven't seen her since we came back...)

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh? Sorry, I must've misunderstood something.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Not long ago, I saw the young lady packing a large bag of cold-weather mountaineering gear, and she was dressed for the job too. I assumed she was heading back with you.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Climbing gear... and specifically for snowy mountains? Are you... absolutely sure?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: No doubt about it. To tell you the truth, it's a hobby of mine as well. We talk about sweet deals on climbing gear a lot, which can save a whole bunch of money!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: If I'm remembering things right, your country's full of snowy mountains, right?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Oh, yes. Yes it is.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (Lady Ensia, surely you didn't...)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (...decide to climb up the mountains alone just to deliver Lady Enya a letter? Knowing Lady Ensia, that IS something she'd do...)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (That can't be it, can it?)

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: If I get a chance, I'd like to take some time off and head over there myself. I've never tried climbing snowy mountains before, so I'll definitely be asking for advice from the locals when the time comes, heh.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (Damn it... I can't get it out of my head!)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (I have to find out for myself... I should've known, there's no way Lady Ensia would have given up just like that!)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (If it really is true, I have to stop her!)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Pardon me, but I must get going!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Huh? Wait, why are you running?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Ah, sorry, but some urgent personal matters came up—

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Kjerag welcomes one and all! I promise I'll take you sightseeing when we get the chance!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Take this road... and then head to the west...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ah! There it is!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That little snow-white summit... So that's what the peaks of Kjerag look like from a distance, huh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Welp, can't really tell how hard that mountain is to climb from this distance. Might even say it looks kinda cute, that holy mountain of ours.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But I know that's a really tough peak to summit. Those who haven't tried it themselves will never truly understand.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Like us Silverashes.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Outsiders could never understand...
My, that's rather unfortunate. Do you see Matterhorn and myself as outsiders too, Lady Ensia?
Though it is true, hearing it does make my heart ache somewhat.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Finally, I've caught up.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Courier?!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Thanks to your unfamiliarity with the terrain, you spent a lot of time taking this part of the route cautiously. Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to catch you.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Wait, wh-why are you here, Courier?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I thought I—— Erm...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: It's too late to stay silent now. 'I thought I didn't tell anyone' is what you wanted to say, right?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: After realizing that I wouldn't help deliver the letter for you, you prepared all this cold-weather mountain-climbing gear and took on a mission that would put you closest to Kjerag.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: After finishing the mission, you'd let the rest of the team head back to Rhodes Island first and take a little detour to 'take care of some personal matters.'

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Such is my Lady Ensia, you certainly do act with great decisiveness.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But, I still ended up getting caught...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: The fact that I saw so many hints but still failed to see through your plan makes me the stupid one.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Lady Ensia, are you planning to scale Mount Karlan again with only your bare hands?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Or, do you plan on barging into the Saintess's residence to deliver your letter, with no consideration for your own safety?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Have you considered what would happen if you made a fuss before the Vine-Bead Court?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ever since I was little, every time I'd try to sneak out to play, you and my brother would always catch me. I never thought I'd be able to keep anything from you two.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You're exactly right. That is my plan. Since I faced down Mount Karlan once, I can do it a second time.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I can't allow it. It's too dangerous!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But if I'm powerless, what else am I to do?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'm always powerless... Powerless to stop the rift between my brother and Enya from growing wider and wider. And I'm expected to just let it happen!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: On the day that Enya left home, I was hiding along the side. I knew she didn't want to go, and we both thought that big brother would protect us, but he didn't lift a finger... He didn't stop those people from taking Enya away.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I thought my sister would cry, but she didn't.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: When I saw her walk out that door, in my heart, I wished that she would've cried out.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Master SilverAsh... also suffers his own hardships.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I know. Even though the two of you never tell me anything, I'm not stupid. I can see it.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ever since he came back from Victoria and founded that company, even you and Uncle Matterhorn have been getting busier. I understand.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I don't want to blame my brother. But, Courier, have you ever seen the Saintess of Kjerag?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Lady Enya? No, you mean, the 'Saintess.'

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Correct. The Kjerag Saintess.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I have, on one occasion. From a distance.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: At first, I was so excited to finally get a chance to see my big sister, but... the only thing I saw was the Saintess of Mount Karlan, standing there as if frozen in ice. From where I stood, there was nothing of my sister.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Ever since then, I knew that Enya could not possibly have been living the life she wanted atop Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: We may have difficulty understanding each others' points of view from our current positions, but... I think Lady Enya is a different person now, you can't look at her like you did then.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: The Saintess is very important to Kjerag, and honestly, Lady Enya's situation may not be so bad. She stands to be the master of an entire religion, the very faith of Kjerag...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That's not the same. Not at all.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You can say that the Saintess is noble, exalted, capable of being detached from our feelings. But our relationship is so much more important— we're literally sisters!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: As siblings, if we never try to understand each other, or even worse, end up becoming enemies one day, what are we going to do then?!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I can't just wait until that day finally comes. I'm scared... so I have to do something.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Even if, even if it's something as simple as asking Enya how she's doing...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: And, what if it's not what you want to hear?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Then I'll just climb up that damned mountain. Lie, cheat, or steal if I must, I'll take her from that place!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'm serious. I'm gonna do it!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Pfft. Hahaha.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Good grief, how can you make something like that sound so simple...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Hey, this is a symbol of my determination! Why are you making fun of me? That's uncalled for, man!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: The determination to lie, cheat, and steal, huh?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Uhhh... That's just a worst-case scenario.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: That's true. I can only pray that the worst will never come to pass. Just thinking about you climbing up the mountain to kidnap her... Ughh, just thinking about it is giving me a headache.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Looks like you won't change your mind no matter what I say, right?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'm not joking. If I say I'll do it, I'll do it!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Even if I insist on stopping you, or reporting this matter to Master SilverAsh—

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Even if my brother objects, even if he wants to lock me up, I won't give in. You'd better not underestimate me, because it's not that simple to shut me down!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I guess that settles it then. You've always had that streak in you, you'll do whatever you set your mind to, and nobody can tell you otherwise. If even Master SilverAsh can't do anything about it, what can I do but surrender?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Hand that letter over to me.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I'd rather not live with the constant worry of wondering when you're going to do something foolish. It's better for me to help you figure out a solution, not to mention safer too.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: *Sigh*... You're really putting me in a rough spot here, Lady Ensia.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You're the best, bro!!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: If my brother is really opposed to it and somehow finds out and plans to punish you, just tell him that it was all my idea!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Haha, if only the Master was so easy to convince.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (whispers) But... this might not be such a bad thing either.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Huh? What'd you say?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Nothing in particular. Just thinking out loud.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: But let me say this in advance, even if I agreed to help, the most I can do is deliver the letter to the nearby monastery and then see if there's any way to get it up the mountain.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: That place is as close as we can get to the area controlled by the Vine-Bead Court. Any higher up into the mountain... and that is no longer a place you can come and go at will.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I cannot guarantee that your letter will reach Lady Enya.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: No problem! The fact that you're willing to help means we at least have a shot... If it doesn't work, I'll just think up some other way!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I hope whatever you think up doesn't involve climbing up there.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Heehee!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (Haha... By the looks of things, she really won't give up.)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (If that day actually comes, Master SilverAsh is going to get the mother of all headaches...)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: One more bowl!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Clo, I can't have another bite... I admit defeat.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Heh heh~ Who gave you the idea to compare your appetite to that of a hungry engineer who hasn't eaten in three days? I'm so hungry I could swallow a meatbeast whole!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: You locked yourself in your workshop again? What'cha working on this time?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Wait a sec, did nobody bring you food? How'd you starve for three days...? What about your little machines?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Eheh... I accidentally set the clearance level of my door to max, plus I was wearing my headphones so I couldn't hear the door at all.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And it's not like I was doing it on purpose! All that fighting with Reunion broke a whole lot of equipment, and repairing everything was giving me a huge headache. Can't even do this job anymore without listening to some music.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That explains it... Thankfully, Amiya went to fish you out today.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: All right, we done yet? I'm not here to listen to a sermon during mealtime!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: By the way, you're here to buy more climbing gear? How come I didn't see you use the cold-weather gear you bought half a year ago?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ah, if there was a problem with the quality, just let me know. I'll go knock some... Er, I'll go bargain with the manufacturer.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: About that, umm, it's not that. There's nothing wrong with the gear, I just didn't need it for the time being.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I'd be more worried if you ended up using it.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That voice... Courier!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Good afternoon.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, afternoon. Did you just get back from a mission? How come you're the only one here?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: The others went to look for the Doctor first.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: As for me, I'm here to pass something on.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Enya... *cough* *cough* 'She' replied?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Awesome! Then let's make like last time and talk over there! Courier? Courier?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: What's going on with you...? You don't look so good. N-Nothing happened with Enya, right?! Or, did something happen to Enciodes—

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Hey, don't panic, there's nothing of the sort...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Then, tell me what's going on!

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Umm... the situation's a bit complicated. But in any case, Lady Ensia, there is one thing Master SilverAsh wanted you to pass on.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: He wants me to... pass on something?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: This is an invitation, for the Doctor——
